title: Access Orchestra: admin onboarding flow with cost context and audit-first canvas
creator: Maya Patel
description: Design a cohesive admin onboarding and role-assignment journey (branded internally as 'Access Orchestra') that surfaces cost implications and audit traces at each decision point. The goal is to reduce misconfigurations at setup, make role grants reviewable, and provide a lightweight audit canvas for compliance reviewers to validate who approved access and why. This work ties into Console dashboards (cost breakdowns) and audit log UX, and should prototype both the first-time admin path and the subsequent access review flow.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype includes an onboarding flow with step-by-step role recommendations and inline cost delta estimates for enabling common roles
Audit canvas shows immutable grant entries with approver, rationale, timestamp, and related cost delta; entries are filterable by workspace, role, and time range
A compact review screen allows security reviewers to flag grants for reapproval and trigger a lightweight reversion flow
Figma mock links, copy doc, and at least one user-tested clickable prototype are attached to this ticket
Design handoff includes component specs (variants, states) and accessibility notes for keyboard/screen reader navigation
design_notes: Prioritize showing cost context early — use estimated per-hour GPU cost and monthly impact when role enables Dedicated/private features
Avoid overwhelming new admins: start with recommended presets (read-only, deployer, billing) and an 'advanced' slot for granular permissions
Audit canvas is read-first: entries are immutable in UI and show linked artifacts (PRs, support tickets) when available
Consider progressive disclosure for KV-cache and serving runtime related permissions — surface only when user plans to touch model hosting or dedicated capacity
Use color tokens aligned with Console theming; red accents only for high-risk grants (e.g., key material export, admin:all)
Make role previews reversible: simulate access with a ‘view as’ sandbox and show sample dashboard/cost view before committing
decisions: Adopt 'cost delta' micro-card pattern on each role row instead of inline badges — less visual noise in long lists
Keep audit entries read-only in the primary canvas and expose 'request reapproval' as the action to create a new linked grant rather than mutating history
Define three default admin archetypes (Viewer, Operator, Owner) and allow workspace-level presets tied to billing units
Use server-generated stable IDs for audit entries to simplify linking from infra and logs (ENG agreed)
Prototype will use a single-screen flow for onboarding + first role assignment to reduce churn during sign-up
review_feedback: PM (Rafael Ortiz): prefer showing monthly cost impact in addition to per-hour; request copy variants for clarity
Eng (Priya Singh): add a note about eventual gating for Dedicated-only permissions; flagged dependency ENG-2789
Security (Elliot Marsh): request explicit KMS export warning modal for any role that includes 'key:export' — added to acceptance criteria
Customer Success (Lena Owens): suggest adding audit-snapshot export (CSV/JSON) to support audits — captured under follow-ups
implementation_tasks: Create UI components: role-row, cost-delta-card, audit-entry-tile
Add API contracts: GET /audit/canvas, POST /grants/request, GET /roles/recommendations
Wire up cost microservice to calculate per-role delta (ENG-2710)
Add e2e tests for onboarding flow and 'request reapproval' action
Accessibility pass: keyboard order, aria-labels for grant actions
